en.reason: Codex CLI 0.157.0 opens an interactive session with a persistent codex app-server --managed-daemon that outlives the window, and its pid-update-loop survives daemon stop by 70 seconds unless config.toml sets daemon_auto_start = false.

en.summary: LangChain releases the langchain-scaledown integration and adds support for ScaleDown's constrained decoding model (CDM) in LangSmith LLM Gateway, cutting the cost and latency of long-horizon agent context management.
en.reason: LangChain released langchain-scaledown, bringing ScaleDown's constrained decoding models to LangSmith LLM Gateway so Deep Agents middleware can summarize old history, compress tool results and extract data, claiming 200x faster and 467x cheaper on narrow tasks.

sources.title_original: Anonymous organization-level registries for Dependabot
sources.recommend_reason_zh: GitHub 为 Dependabot 的组织级私有 registry 新增 Anonymous 认证，适合无需凭据即可访问的内部镜像；由于不能更改现有 registry 的认证方式，曾用占位 token 绕过的用户需删除后重建，该功能已在 github.com 全面可用，并将随 GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24 推出。

en.reason: GitHub added Anonymous authentication to Dependabot's organization-level private registries for internal mirrors needing no credentials, but existing registries can't change auth methods and must be deleted and recreated; it's live on github.com and ships with GitHub Enterprise Server 3.24.
